auroc_verified_explanation: exp2484 (5-seed simple replication of the .239 0.9351 claim) tautology_resolved=True but hive_peer_breached=False; true_replicated_auroc_isotonic=0.7964 with 95% CI [0.548, 1.045] does NOT reach the HIVE peer 0.9236. The headline 0.9351 number from .239 (exp2473) is therefore NOT cite-safe in paper-v6 as a single-method claim. exp2485 group-conditional calibration achieved 0.975 (std 0.021, n=5 seeds) — this DOES breach HIVE 0.9236 and the breach is statistically meaningful given the small std. The strict gate auroc_adversarially_verified requires BOTH tautology_resolved AND hive_peer_breached on exp2484; since hive_peer_breached_exp2484=False the strict gate is False even though group-conditional (exp2485) breached separately.
phase4_explanation: Both .240 Phase 4 attempts returned phase4_validated=False. exp2486 (ARM-EBM bijection): pearson_r=0.108 on n=36, ARM↔EBM correlation indistinguishable from noise; arm_ebm_auroc=0.5162 (chance-level). exp2487 (Qwen PRC divergence): energy_prc_mean=energy_neutral_mean=-2.0125 (no detectable elevation under PRC perturbation); honest disclosure model_used='mock_model' rather than the real Qwen GGUF — methodology gap, not a refutation. Phase 4 hypothesis remains not_validated; the verifier-as-free-energy claim is unsupported by the .240 evidence and the operator hold on arXiv submission persists.
kv260_status: bitstream_generated; flash requires Vivado hw_server with Digilent JTAG HS2 programmer purchase (DirtyJTAG physically incompatible: 3.3V vs 1.8V level mismatch; OpenOCD ZynqMP PS init absent from xilinx_zynqmp.cfg)
arxiv_readiness_assessment: arXiv NOT YET ready: 2 of 4 gates met. Phase 1 ship gate met (.236 exp2441) and audit_passed_after_fix=True (.239 exp2479). However phase4_validated_any=False (both exp2486 ARM-EBM and exp2487 Qwen PRC returned not-validated; latter used mock_model — methodology gap rather than refutation) AND auroc_adversarially_verified=False (exp2484 5-seed replication of the .239 0.9351 claim gave 0.7964 with CI [0.548, 1.045], failing to breach HIVE 0.9236). Paper-v6 cannot cite 0.9351 as headline; the cite-safe AUROC is exp2485 group-conditional 0.975 (does breach HIVE) but only as the calibration-method headline, not the simple-fusion claim. Operator hold remains in place. Forward plan: (a) re-attempt Phase 4 with real Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF rather than mock_model in .241+; (b) replace paper-v6 headline AUROC with exp2485 group-conditional 0.975; (c) keep PolarFire terminal-state achievement and KAN certified deployment as supporting evidence.

synthesis.milestone_summary: Milestone 2026.05.240 closed with 10/10 capstone-input artifacts present and adversarially scrutinized. AUROC adversarial resolution: the .239 claim of 0.9351 (exp2473, flagged TAUTOLOGY) did NOT survive 5-seed simple-fusion replication — exp2484 gave 0.7964 with 95% CI [0.548, 1.045], so the bare 0.9351 number is retired as paper-v6 headline. exp2485 group-conditional calibration recovered with mean AUROC 0.975 (std 0.021, n=5 seeds) which DOES breach HIVE 0.9236; this becomes the cite-safe headline if paper-v6 narrates the calibration choice explicitly. Phase 4 attempts both failed: ARM-EBM bijection (exp2486) saw pearson_r=0.108 (noise floor) on n=36, and Qwen PRC divergence (exp2487) showed no elevation but honestly disclosed it used mock_model rather than the real GGUF — a methodology gap that justifies one more Phase 4 attempt in .241+ with the real model before declaring the verifier-as-free-energy hypothesis refuted. KAN retrain (exp2489) achieved certified_deployment_ready=True with new_certified_coverage=0.833 and AUROC 0.974. PolarFire reached terminal state: carnot_runs_on_polarfire=True on the riscv64 SoC (energy_sanity_check still pending). KV260 flash is blocked on programmer hardware: DirtyJTAG is physically incompatible (3.3V vs 1.8V), OpenOCD lacks the ZynqMP PS init script; the only forward path is a Digilent JTAG HS2 programmer purchase plus Vivado hw_server. arXiv submission readiness: 2 of 4 gates met; operator hold persists until Phase 4 validates with a real model AND the paper-v6 headline switches to the cite-safe 0.975 group-conditional number.
